Genuine vitest suite (imports describe/it from vitest, not @playwright/test) sitting inside the playwright testDir (tests/e2e). vitest.config.ts excludes tests/e2e/** wholesale; `playwright test --list` finds 0 tests in it (no playwright test() calls). Invisible to BOTH runners. When run standalone: 7/11 fail (production-guard tests mutate process.env.NODE_ENV at runtime, but auth.middleware.ts:27 caches isProductionEnv at module load, so the guard never re-evaluates — the test cannot validate what it claims to). Needs owner triage; not fixed in this test-discovery sprint.
